NEW THEMES:
5 darker themes have been added as the first 5 themes are very light and can bother some players.

WINDOW MODE:
The option to put the game in window mode has been added, so you can resize the window to the size you want. (I'm not entirely satisfied with that yet, but it is working and I would like you to have access to this feature. Soon it will be improved)

that's it for now, I hope you liked it!

Thanks!!!
